title: Borrowed Crown
style: Hybrid pop-rap with swaggering half-time drums, elastic bass, and genre-switching section energy; verse one rides clipped rap cadence over sparse keys, pre-chorus opens with stacked harmonies and filtered snare lift, chorus hits with a bold sing-rap hook and gang ad-libs, verse two shifts to slicker melodic phrasing, bridge drops to a stripped chant before the final chorus returns bigger with handclaps, reverse swells, and bright punchy mix
